style.backgroundSystem: one flat field per shot, never mixed: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, blush-coral panel #F2B8AC for benefit, use and set screens, warm greige board #E7E0DB for skin macros and infographic screens
style.direction: soft coral beauty patch ecommerce, tidy retail infographic
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, filled dot markers in accent #E24B3B, check and cross positions kept empty, one rounded card radius throughout
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light at 5600K, front-left key with white bounce fill, contact shadows only, a thin skim of side light reserved for texture macros, no hard speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft coral beauty ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, blush-coral panel #F2B8AC, warm greige board #E7E0DB and one vermillion accent #E24B3B with deep charcoal type; bright soft high-key studio lighting at 5600K with a front-left key, white bounce fill and contact shadows only, a thin skim of side light for texture macros; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline weight and one light body weight; thin-line icons and empty dot markers in the accent; matte paper and greige board surfaces only; stable locked product angle and scale; identity-free skin crops throughout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented claims or numbers.
noDrift: no recognizable faces or invented brand wordmarks
no invented numbers, rankings or certifications
style.presentationRules: retail box keeps the same straight-on or slight 3/4 hero angle and locked scale; loose patches always read as clean round discs with a tapered curling rim; skin is only ever an identity-free partial crop
style.surfaceSystem: matte studio paper and warm greige board #E7E0DB, low matte ledge for lineup screens, no wood or marble grain, no reflective acrylic
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy headline weight plus one light body weight, deep charcoal type, every in-image line stays a blank placeholder slot
